name: Gallows Hollow
description: A hidden outlaw camp in a fold of the Windy Foothills. Its inhabitants have made a rough but deliberate settlement from canvas, stolen supplies, and a watched approach trail.

trailhead.name: Hidden Trailhead
trailhead.description: A sheep track turns sharply into a fold between the hills. Fresh boot marks have trampled the grass, and a broken branch has been set upright as a quiet warning to strangers.

bramble_screen.name: Bramble Screen
bramble_screen.description: Thorny brambles have been bent and tied into a living screen across the hollow. A narrow gap has been kept open for people who know where to look.

watch_perch.name: Watch Perch
watch_perch.description: A shelf of pale rock overlooks the approach trail and much of the foothills beyond. A concealed firing rest and a scatter of spent arrow shafts show how the camp keeps its privacy.

campfire_ring.name: Campfire Ring
campfire_ring.description: Canvas lean-tos encircle a soot-blackened fire pit. The outlaws have separate piles for food, weapons, and goods stripped from passing wagons; this is an organised camp, not a chance bivouac.

supply_gully.name: Supply Gully
supply_gully.description: A narrow gully behind the camp holds tarped bundles and a damaged handcart. The most useful-looking loot has been hidden beneath old blankets, ready to be moved before the camp is discovered.
